topic: Why your AI coding agent keeps rewriting files it should not touch
title: Why your coding agent rewrites files it should not touch
description: Agents rewrite whole files because the instruction never said where the edit ends. One rule fixes most of it: name the file and the function before you ask for the change.

cues.text: Your agent rewrote the whole file
cues.narration: Your AI agent just rewrote a whole file you never asked it to touch. Here is why.
An agent reads your request like a stranger in a quiet diner. It knows what you want, not where the change is supposed to stop.
So a vague instruction turns into a vague edit. The scope fractures, and it fixes things you never mentioned.

cues.text: Name the file. Name the function.
cues.narration: The fix is a boundary. Name the file, name the function, and say what must not change.
Do that and the agent plays inside the level you drew. Small edits, every time.

outro: Follow for one build lesson a day.
